name: dogfood
description: A quality assurance app for any project: your coding agent reviews every page systematically, and you watch quality on an ongoing basis.

scripts.check: for f in server.mjs mcp.mjs lib/*.mjs public/js/*.mjs public/js/views/*.mjs; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && DOGFOOD_DATA=demo node scripts/check-projects.mjs
scripts.test:acceptance: for f in tests/acceptance/*.mjs; do echo "$f"; node "$f" || exit 1; done
